title: The MetForm – Contact Form, Survey, Quiz, Conditional Forms, Form Templates & Custom Form Builder for Elementor plugin…
description: The MetForm plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 4.3.3 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'mf-te' parameter in the Text Editor field. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access the affected pages. Exploitation requires a published form containing a Text Editor block, where the form's public markup exposes a submission nonce that attackers can use to bypass submission barriers and store payloads.
